# Ponytail for DeepSeek Harness

An unofficial port of Ponytail 5.3.3 ("lazy senior dev mode") to the DeepSeek
Harness (DSH). It keep

s the upstream minimal-code rules exactly as written and
adds native DSH surfaces: a settings tab, a

mode picker, a status band in the
composer, and a usage dashboard.

Upstream source: DietrichGebert/ponytail
(MIT). This is an unofficial port, not affiliated with upst

eam source: DietrichGebert/ponytail
(MIT). This is an unofficial port, not affiliated with upstream.

Beta. Host adapter and packaged-plugin tests pass on Windows with DSH 0.2.1-rc.3
and rc.5; macOS Des
ktop UI is not yet verified.

Compatibility peers allow DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3` and `<0.3.0`. CI checks the current
latest, alpha, and
rc.3 daily, and future prereleases can still break APIs.
## Install
### DSH Desktop — easiest

On a DSH version whose Plugins sidebar offers **Add plugin** (supported Desktop
versions): open **Pl

ugins**, choose **Add plugin**, enter
`@kb1slnlabs/dsh-ponytail@5.3.3-dsh.6`, then review/install an

d enable it when
prompted. Fully quit DSH and reopen it, and create a new conversation.

If you want a different default intensity, select `ultra` in the Ponytail settings;
the package defa

ult is `full`. The exact location of those settings may vary by DSH
version. If another Ponytail ada

pter is already installed, remove it first — see
Coming from another adapter.

Desktop's UI installs into its own profile, so the terminal commands below are
alternatives, not ext

DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 CLI

. If you use the desktop app, use its bundled CLI instead (see
"Desktop app" below). Close any runni

ng DSH process after installing, then start it
again.

### Desktop app

The desktop app ships its own CLI. An older globally installed CLI refuses the
reserved `desktop` pr

ofile; the bundled one works. Use the bundled CLI with the
`desktop` profile and the ordinary instal

ile; the bundled one works. Use the bundled CLI with the
`desktop` profile and the ordinary install:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
On macOS the Desktop app's bundled CLI lives inside the application bundle:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The bundled CLI supports the same alternate sources shown above — `github:`, a
`file:` tarball path,
or a local `link:` checkout.

Restart DSH, then open **Settings → Plugins → Ponytail**. Choose a default mode (for
example, `ultra

`) and save. The package default is `full`. For details on profile
configuration and migration, see
the adapter reference.
## Everyday use
| Command | What it does |

| `/ponytail` | Opens the mode picker (when the UI is available) |
| `/ponytail lite` / `full` / `ul

tra` / `off` | Sets the mode for this session |
| `/ponytail status` | Shows the current mode and wh

ere it comes from |
| `/ponytail reset` | Drops this session's override |
Modes: `lite`, `full` (upstream default), `ultra`, and `off`.

There are also one-shot commands: `/ponytail-review`, `/ponytail-audit`,
`/ponytail-debt`, `/ponytai

l-gain`, `/ponytail-help`. The review, audit, and other
skill commands start model work. Mode and su

bcommands like `status` or `help` do
not.

Profile settings survive a restart. Session overrides set with `/ponytail <mode>` reset
when the pro

cess restarts. See the [default precedence
reference](docs/REFERENCE.md#config--default-precedence)

for environment and global
defaults.
## Screenshots

Both images show **demonstration data** rendered through the actual plugin
components.
*Status band (expanded): Demonstration data.*
*Dashboard: Demonstration data.*
## What the numbers mean

- The dashboard shows whole-session usage as reported by the provider, grouped by
the date each sess

ion was last updated. Filters decide which sessions get read;
sessions with no update date appear on

ly under **All**.
- Sessions without usable usage are listed as unavailable, and coverage counts say

how many of the selected sessions carry usage.
- Active time is completed-turn elapsed time and inc

ludes waiting on approvals and
tools.
- The test command shown in the status band is the current pro

cess's last recorded
simple foreground test command. Its exit code is evidence for that command only

,
not proof about a whole suite.
- No cost or savings estimates are made for your sessions. `/ponyta

il-gain` shows the
upstream benchmark reference.

Details on history semantics, contracts, and limitations:
adapter reference, DESIGN.md, PRODUCT.md.
## Coming from another adapter

If `@mengyuly/dsh-ponytail` is installed, remove that plugin first, then follow the
migration sectio

n of the reference
to replace its override row and keep your settings.
